description: Zones inondables - hauteur d'eau en mètre - Etat Fil de l'eau PAPI BSA - T1 module is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Flood zones - water height in meters - as part of the modeling of the wire state of the water PAPI BSA - current state - Hydroclimatic scenario (Maritime M1 - River flow Module). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood zones - water height in meters - Condition Water wire PAPI BSA - T1 module" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include lutte contre les inondations, changement climatique, crue, tempête, inondation, Risque naturel. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
